chapters.title: From ETL pain points to a unified Fabric
Why Gen2 changes how data teams work

takeaways: Dataflows Gen2 makes transformations a first-class Fabric resource, so one definition feeds the lakehouse, warehouse and Power BI.
Compute separation and managed staging let teams scale transformation power on demand and stop paying for leftover temporary data.
Git integration with branches, reviews and commit history turns ETL into a collaborative, auditable engineering practice.
hook: Duplicated Power Query scripts, parallel pipelines and reports that never agree are the daily cost of fragmented ETL. This episode is for data and BI teams moving to Microsoft Fabric who want to understand how Dataflows Gen2, with compute separation, managed staging and Git integration, replaces workarounds with one maintainable data flow.
